statement: Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r, let n = len(temperatures). Then len(r) = n, and for every i with 0 <= i < n the following holds. If there exists j with i < j < n and temperatures[j] > temperatures[i], then r[i] is the smallest positive integer d such that i + d < n and temperatures[i + d] > temperatures[i]; equivalently r[i] = d, temperatures[i + d] > temperatures[i], and temperatures[i + k] <= temperatures[i] for every integer k with 0 < k < d. If no such j exists, then r[i] = 0.
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r, len(r) = len(temperatures).
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(temperatures), 0 <= r[i] <= len(temperatures) - 1 - i.
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(temperatures), r[i] = 0 if and only if every j with i < j < len(temperatures) satisfies temperatures[j] <= temperatures[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(temperatures), if r[i] > 0 then i + r[i] < len(temperatures) and temperatures[i + r[i]] > temperatures[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r, for every i and every integer d with 0 <= i < len(temperatures) and 0 < d < r[i], i + d < len(temperatures) and temperatures[i + d] <= temperatures[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r, r[len(temperatures) - 1] = 0.
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(temperatures) - 1, r[i] = 1 if and only if temperatures[i + 1] > temperatures[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(temperatures), if temperatures[i] = 100 then r[i] = 0.
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(temperatures) - 1, if temperatures[i] = temperatures[i + 1], then r[i] = 0 if and only if r[i + 1] = 0, and if r[i + 1] > 0 then r[i] = r[i + 1] + 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: For every integer c such that 30 <= temperatures[i] + c <= 100 for all i with 0 <= i < n, let t' be the slice of length n with t'[i] = temperatures[i] + c. Whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns r and daily_temperatures(t') returns r', len(r) = len(r') and r[i] = r'[i] for every i with 0 <= i < n.
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: For every index i with 0 <= i < n and every slice b of length n satisfying 30 <= b[k] <= 100 for all 0 <= k < n and b[k] = temperatures[k] for every k with i <= k < n, whenever daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns r and daily_temperatures(b) returns r_b, r[i] = r_b[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: For every slice temperatures of 64-bit integers satisfying the preconditions, daily_temperatures(temperatures) returns a result r; it does not overflow, go out of bounds, or panic.
preconditions: Let n = len(temperatures). 1 <= n <= 100000 and 30 <= temperatures[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < n.
